title: Tawantinsuyu and the Qhapaq Ñan: the Inca empire and its roads
goal: Say how the Inca empire was organised and connected, using the se passive.

items: I can say what was built, used or kept with the passive *se* (*se construyeron*, *se usaban*).
I can say what Tawantinsuyu and the Qhapaq Ñan were.
I can use the new words for the empire: *chasqui*, *quipu*, *imperio*, *puente*.
